newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Eight people killed in violence in Karachi.
newsitem.headline: Eight people killed in violence in Karachi.

text.p: Eight people, including a policeman, were killed in various violent incidents in the Pakistani city of Karachi on Saturday, police said.
They said two gunmen on a motorcycle shot dead police constable Shah Murad, 35, near New Town police station.
In a separate incident, gunmen kidnapped, tortured and hanged a 22-year-old man, before dumping his body in a sewer in the volatile Liaquatabad area of District Central, police said.

A 25-year-old man identified only as Sardar was stabbed to death in District South. Dir Faraz, 30, was shot dead in Quaidabad and gunfire killed Syed Mumtaz Hussain in North Nazimabad in District Central. Three other people were killed in separate areas of the southern port city, police said.
There was no immediate word on the motive for any of the attacks in Karachi, where violence has risen amid tension between rival wings of the ethnic Mohajir National Movement.
